description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that acts as a wrapper for Android's logging system, providing static methods to log messages at various levels and manage log nodes. It facilitates chaining log nodes for customized logging behavior.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class for managing log outputs, wrapping Android's native Log and enabling chaining of LogNode objects for custom logging implementations.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message or Throwable at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message or Throwable at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message or Throwable at ASSERT level, indicating a critical failure.
